Retire / restore / remove
archive_project_item preserves values
Unarchive restores the same item
remove_issue_from_project loses values
confirmRemove; open OR closed issue

div.div:
Board metadata is not issue state
Project-only changes never close/delete the issue or write its cache. Adding and moving require an OPEN issue.
Field updates, clears, archive/unarchive, and removal also accept CLOSED issues.
Use issue tools—not custom project fields—to change labels, assignees, or milestones.
